articleBodyHtml:
One Piece and Filler Episodes

The speaker mentions that their brother is a fan of 'One Piece' and believes that filler episodes should not be skipped. This indicates that the brother values the continuity and development of the story, even if it includes filler content.

The speaker questions whether skipping filler episodes is appropriate, suggesting that it may depend on how much of a 'One Piece' fan one is. They also mention a character named Uta, though they clarify that Uta is not a filler episode.
